exceptions.owner: Speak repository security and release owner
exceptions.technicalBlocker: The latest official qwen-tts release, 0.1.1, requires transformers==4.57.3. The patched Transformers 5.x line is not API-compatible with the current Qwen runtime.
exceptions.exploitabilityAssessment: The vulnerable Trainer checkpoint-loading path is not imported or used by Speak's Qwen inference workers.
compensatingControls: Qwen runs offline with local model directories only.
Model validation rejects executable, pickle-based, symlinked, custom-code, auto_map, custom_pipelines, and unsafe attention configuration content.
The worker never invokes Transformers Trainer APIs.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Upgrade to a tested qwen-tts release compatible with a non-vulnerable Transformers version, then remove the pip-audit ignore and this exception.
exceptions.approval: Accepted for the Speak 0.5.2 release with weekly review and expiry enforcement.

exceptions.owner: Speak repository security and release owner
exceptions.technicalBlocker: qwen-tts 0.1.1 exactly pins Transformers 4.57.3, while the patched 5.3+ line is currently incompatible with Qwen audio generation.
exceptions.exploitabilityAssessment: The exploit requires attacker-controlled remote model configuration or downloaded kernels. Speak forces offline mode, accepts local directories only, and rejects the unsafe configuration field before model import.
compensatingControls: HF_HUB_OFFLINE and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE are set before Transformers imports.
Model validation rejects _attn_implementation_internal, auto_map, custom_pipelines, and trust_remote_code content.
Remote repositories and custom kernels are not accepted by the Qwen worker.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Upgrade to a tested qwen-tts release compatible with Transformers 5.3 or later and remove this exception.
exceptions.approval: Accepted for the Speak 0.5.2 release with offline-only model loading and expiry enforcement.

exceptions.owner: Speak repository security and release owner
exceptions.technicalBlocker: The patched Transformers 5.5+ line cannot currently replace the exact 4.57.3 dependency required by qwen-tts 0.1.1 without breaking Qwen generation.
exceptions.exploitabilityAssessment: The vulnerable LightGlue nested model-loading path is unrelated to Qwen TTS and is not imported. Speak also rejects remote or custom model code.
compensatingControls: Only validated local Qwen model trees are accepted.
LightGlue and nested AutoModel remote loading are not used.
Custom Python, native executables, symlinks, auto_map, and trust_remote_code are rejected.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Upgrade to a tested qwen-tts release compatible with Transformers 5.5 or later and remove this exception.
exceptions.approval: Accepted for the Speak 0.5.2 release because the affected model family is not reachable and local model validation is enforced.

exceptions.owner: Speak repository security and release owner
exceptions.technicalBlocker: qwen-tts 0.1.1 requires Transformers 4.57.3; replacing it with the patched 5.x line is not currently release-safe.
exceptions.exploitabilityAssessment: The issue requires deserializing a malicious X-CLIP checkpoint. Speak does not use X-CLIP and rejects pickle-based or executable model material.
compensatingControls: X-CLIP conversion and checkpoint import are not used.
Pickle weights, executable files, symlinks, and custom model code are rejected.
Qwen model loading is offline and local-only.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Upgrade the Qwen stack to a non-vulnerable Transformers release and remove this exception.
exceptions.approval: Accepted for the Speak 0.5.2 release with local data-only model restrictions and expiry enforcement.

exceptions.owner: Speak repository security and release owner
exceptions.technicalBlocker: The official CUDA 12.6 index provides Torch 2.13 but no matching TorchAudio 2.13 build. Qwen imports torchaudio.compliance.kaldi, and TorchAudio documents that its binaries must match the corresponding Torch release.
exceptions.exploitabilityAssessment: The advisory requires torch.jit.script on attacker-controlled code. Speak's Qwen path does not use torch.jit.script and accepts only validated local model data.
compensatingControls: The Qwen worker does not call torch.jit.script.
Only validated local Qwen model trees are accepted.
The Dependabot alert remains open and is reviewed weekly rather than dismissed.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Move Qwen to a tested, officially matched Torch and TorchAudio pair at or above the patched Torch version, then close the open alert and remove this exception.
exceptions.approval: Accepted for the Speak 0.5.2 release while the alert remains visible and matching official binaries are unavailable.

exceptions.owner: Speak repository security and release owner
exceptions.technicalBlocker: Qwen currently requires Torch 2.12.1, whose official wheel metadata requires setuptools<82. The advisory is fixed in setuptools 83.0.0, so the patched version makes the official Qwen dependency graph unsatisfiable.
exceptions.exploitabilityAssessment: The issue affects Unicode normalization while building source distributions on macOS APFS or HFS+. Speak 0.5.2 is a Windows application, uses prebuilt wheels, and does not build or publish source distributions at runtime.
compensatingControls: Speak supports Windows and does not execute Qwen packaging workflows on macOS.
The runtime installs pinned prebuilt wheels and never builds source distributions from untrusted file trees.
The exception is expiry-enforced and removed when the Qwen Torch stack permits setuptools 83 or later.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Move Qwen to a tested Torch release that permits setuptools 83.0.0 or later, then remove the audit ignore and this exception.
exceptions.approval: Accepted for the Windows-only Speak 0.5.2 release because the affected source-distribution path is not used.
